tagline: A leader in car accident cases in Connecticut & Tri-State Area — Serving community since 1957.
about: Ventura Law has been a preeminent legal resource in Connecticut and the Tri-State Area since 1957. With a long-standing tradition of excellence, their attorneys have provided exemplary guidance to businesses, public entities, and individuals. Boasting a wealth of experience and knowledge, Ventura Law competes at the same level as large national and international firms. Their attorneys are highly respected in their field and have set a standard for the legal profession.
